title: Neonatal continuous infusions: standard concentrations and label dose ranges
_conventions: concentrations[].v is per 1 mL unless per_ml is given (sources write X unit/mL). ASHP S4S pediatric standards are for children under 50 kg; VON standards are NICU (table 1: 500 g or more, table 2: less than 500 g current weight). range is present only when an FDA label states a neonatal or pediatric rate; adult-only ranges are left out. initial[] holds label starting rates. highAlert follows the ISMP 2018 acute care list (highAlertBasis).

range.basis: FDA label statement for adults and pediatric patients (start 2 to 5, maximum 50); not neonatal-specific
range.quote: The recommended starting dosage in adults and pediatric patients is 2 to 5 mcg/kg/minute as a continuous intravenous infusion [see Dosage and Administration (2.3) ] .
